name: 13492 · Whitesboro, NY
findings: ZIP 13492 (Whitesboro) has 34 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 13492 (Whitesboro) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 13492 (Whitesboro) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 71% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
